name: sync_batch::run

test_list.description: The bounded parser preserves exact payload bytes and rejects protected workspace paths.
Digest mismatch and non-synthetic tar members are rejected before mutation.
Production root confinement logic rejects the trusted base itself and linked escapes.
Partial application returns exact applied and unstarted paths without claiming rollback.
Expected-state mismatch rejects the batch before changes and preserves the intervening file.
Batch install preserves CRLF, executable bit, relative link target and conditional deletion.

inputs.name: archive_path
inputs.description: One bounded archive staged directly under the private sync staging directory.

output_description: Exit 0 emits JSON covering every requested path exactly once; nonzero means the host must rescan because outcome may be uncertain.
